messages:
alex_p: Need urgent comp band exception approved for offer to L4 SWE candidate. Offer on the table, start date 2025-04-07. Details: base $210k, L3 cap $195k. Requesting exception to L4 band. @maria_peopleops please advise routing.
maria_peopleops: Can you paste candidate ID + req? Also confirm manager sign-off.
dan_engineering: Manager sign-off done via email this morning (dan). Req: RQ-824.
recruiter_kim: Candidate verbally accepted contingent on final comp. They asked about a $15k sign-on to hit target comp if band not approved. Also needs relocation timeline.
alex_p: Candidate ID CAND-9382. Uploading the offer packet to the sheet now.
recruiter_kim: Uploaded offer packet: offer_CAND-9382.pdf and candidate notes.
people_ops_bot: Approval flow created: reviewers = hiring_mgr, hiring_dir, finance, people_ops_lead. Doc: https://redwood.internal/approvals/1755006789
maria_peopleops: Routing checklist: 1) manager sign-off (done) 2) director sign-off 3) finance approval 4) people-ops lead sign-off. @jordan_peopleops please triage when you can.
luke_finance: Finance here — I can fast-track budget check but need a brief justification memo and confirm which cost center.
alex_p: Cost center ENG-PLAT-01. Adding a short justification to the approval doc now.
recruiter_kim: Candidate asked: if we delay start to 4/21 will we lose them? They seem keen on April 7th.
maria_peopleops: If we can't secure the band today, fallback option: start at current band with an increased sign-on and do a band correction/adjustment after 6 months. That requires exec approval and is higher overhead.
dan_engineering: We'd strongly prefer to keep 4/7 and approve band. Can finance escalate?
luke_finance: I escalated to FP and flagged as high priority. Uploading memo here: https://redwood.internal/fin/memos/1755-memo.pdf
jordan_peopleops: I can review — give me until 3pm PST. If all docs look solid I can sign.
people_ops_bot: Background-check reminder: candidate BGC must be cleared before onboarding. Recruiter to confirm timeline.
recruiter_kim: Background check initiated today — vendor ETA 48-72h. Candidate ok with remote onboarding paperwork.
maria_peopleops: One more ask: confirm payroll locus (US W2 vs contractor). If W2, payroll setup lead time is ~5 business days.
alex_p: This is US W2.
jordan_peopleops: Approved. maria_peopleops, please finalize the offer letter with L4 band effective date 2025-04-07 and update comp table. @alex_p follow up with candidate.
recruiter_kim: Will update candidate and send executed offer after final doc. :thumbsup:
people_ops_bot: Approval status: APPROVED by jordan_peopleops; FINANCE_PENDING -> luke_finance escalated.
luke_finance: Finance sign-off complete as of 1755007020.
maria_peopleops: Great — finalizing paperwork now. I'll attach the signed pdf to the approval doc and confirm start logistics.
alex_p: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.
recruiter_kim: Confirmed with candidate they remain committed to 4/7. Closing thread once offer letter uploaded.
